question: show all districts 2023 employed divided women enrolled ascending
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_percent ASC, district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, CAST(T2.employed_at_6_months AS REAL) / NULLIF(T2.women_enrolled, 0) FROM maternal_services AS T1 INNER JOIN livelihoods AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2023 ORDER BY CAST(T2.employed_at_6_months AS REAL) / NULLIF(T2.women_enrolled, 0) ASC NULLS FIRST
